data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 月夜庭院
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 月夜庭院】银装素裹的城堡后庭院在冷月清辉下静谧如画，伊莉雅穿着厚厚的紫色连帽斗篷在深雪中踩出串串小巧的脚印。她转过身张开双臂像一只快乐的雪蝶——「大哥哥快看！雪地好软好舒服！不快点跟上来的话，我可是要让狂战士把你抓起来咯！」
data.action: 在雪地踩出脚印后转身张开双臂，厚斗篷闭合保暖，笑着等待同行者
data.camera: full-body shot, outstretched arms and trail of footprints visible
data.promptProse: A footprint trail crosses the snowy castle garden to Illyasviel, who turns and spreads both arms to welcome her following companion. Her thick purple hooded cloak stays closed over warm clothes, winter boots pressed securely into the snow. Keep her full balanced figure and the trail in the vertical view, frozen pine branches farther back. Moonlight edges her white hair and cloak, leaving blue-grey shadows inside the footprints.
